title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: We’d heard glowing reviews of Peruvian cuisine, but honestly found ourselves captivated only by the national dish, lomo saltado, which became our go-to meal.
Street meats (including alpaca and guinea pigs!) were delicious snacks to fuel us between meals.
In Lima, we liked Punto Azul in Miraflores for ceviche, and for a bigger spread try Panchita, which is also in Miraflores. In the other towns, we opportunistically ate wherever a table was available!
